name: Royal Quarter
summary: In the Royal Quarter, Sylvanas Windrunner directs the Forsaken from her throne. Varimathras stands at her side, and Royal Dreadguards guard the seat of power beneath the Undercity.

sections.title: The Seat of the Dark Lady
sections.body: The Forsaken make their military and political decisions in the Royal Quarter, also called the Hall of the Dark Lady. Beneath the Undercity, Sylvanas Windrunner holds court in its vast chamber. She works for the survival of her free-willed undead and the destruction of the Scourge. Royal Dreadguards watch along the dais, shielding their queen from uninvited visitors and would-be assassins.

sections.title: A Dangerous Alliance
sections.body:
Varimathras, a nathrezim, stands beside Sylvanas in the heart of the Undercity. During the civil war in the ruins of Lordaeron, he sided with her to save his own life and pledged loyalty to her cause. From the Royal Quarter, he commands deathstalkers and coordinates defenses across the realm.

His tactical skill aids the Forsaken, yet many Horde allies distrust his true allegiance because he is a demon.

faq.q: Who rules from the Royal Quarter?
aliases: who is in the royal quarter
faq.answer: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, the Banshee Queen, rules the Forsaken from the Royal Quarter. The nathrezim Varimathras stands beside her, having pledged loyalty during the reconquest of Lordaeron.

faq.q: Why is there a dreadlord standing in the throne room?
aliases: why is demon in royal quarter
faq.answer: During the reconquest of Capital City, Varimathras surrendered to Sylvanas Windrunner, then betrayed his brothers Detheroc and Balnazzar. He saved his own life by swearing loyalty to Sylvanas. Now he is her enforcer and master of scouts.
The Royal Dreadguards are elite Forsaken chosen to protect Lady Sylvanas and the Royal Quarter. They are among the Undercity's most disciplined and deadly defenders.

faq.q: What other function does this chamber serve?
aliases: what else is in royal quarter
faq.answer: The Royal Quarter also holds audiences for the Dark Lady and Varimathras, and houses battlemasters. They coordinate Horde combatants for foreign campaigns and strategic skirmishes across Azeroth.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, the Royal Quarter is the heart of their independence. Sylvanas Windrunner and her dreadlord lieutenant chart the future of their liberated people there.
Horde envoys visiting the Royal Quarter often regard the Dark Lady's nathrezim councilor with deep suspicion. They question the wisdom of trusting a demon in the heart of a Horde capital.
